name: snapcraft-publish-action
description: A Github action that publishes snapcraft projects

scripts.pack: esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=esm --banner:js='import {createRequire} from "node:module"; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);' --outfile=dist/index.js
scripts.all: npm run build && npm run format-check && npm run lint && npm run pack && npm test

author: James Henstridge
